subject.title: fix(diagnostics): reclaim zombie embedded-run counters left idle by handle-mismatch clears

question: Should OpenClaw land idle/no-queue stale embedded-run active-abort recovery after refreshing this branch, or wait for a root-cause/prevention fix instead?
rationale: The code path is a plausible mitigation for a real user stall, but it can force-clear active-run ownership from an idle diagnostic state and must be reconciled with newer recovery and dispatch-liveness work.

options.title: Refresh And Reconcile Recovery Policy
options.body: Resolve the conflict, preserve current progress-age recovery behavior, compare against adjacent dispatch-liveness work, and rerun focused diagnostics validation before merge.

options.title: Accept The Bounded Mitigation
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept force-clearing stale idle active-run bookkeeping after the abort threshold as the desired recovery tradeoff.

options.title: Pause For Root-Cause Prevention
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers require a live Slack reproduction or a prevention fix for the handle leak before changing recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Reconcile Recovery Policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict, preserve current progress-age recovery behavior, compare against adjacent dispatch-liveness work, and rerun focused diagnostics validation before merge.
